name: metadata
source: Esri REST docs: Geometry Service resource (https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/services-reference/enterprise/geometry-service.htm); sampleserver6/Geometry/GeometryServer pattern
notes: Resource metadata: version + capability list. Our version/capabilities honestly describe this engine, not Esri's.
knownDeltas: currentVersion/serviceDescription describe the SpatialEngine build, not Esri's; the capability verb list is the parity contract.
FindTransformations is documented by Esri but this host does not advertise it (no datum tables by design, ADR-0009); dispatching it is an honest invalid.arguments reject.
